## 抓取原文


> 公开版只收录上面"论断"里的原文摘句，全文请看来源链接。

The survey suggests the barriers are less about budget and more about people and process.

Almost nine in ten organisations said a lack of internal technical capability was holding back AI ambitions.

While most CIOs said they use AI governance controls to some extent, 62% reported compromising on governance because of limited knowledge.

Only 44% said they fully grasp the risks of AI adoption.

Governance emerged as another pressure point.

The results suggest many CIOs do not yet feel fully equipped to assess risks consistently across these areas.
